name: Convergence of Dominion
oracle_text:
Dynastic Command Node — As long as you control your commander, activated abilities of cards in your graveyard cost {2} less to activate. This effect can't reduce the mana in that ability's activation cost to less than one mana.
Translocation Protocols — {3}, {T}: Mill three cards.
blocked_sentences: Dynastic Command Node — As long as you control your commander, activated abilities of cards in your graveyard cost {2} less to activate. This effect can't reduce the mana in that ability's activation cost to less than one mana.

needs.what: an ability_cost_reduction static that reaches activated abilities of cards in a graveyard (affects: {zone: graveyard, owner/controller: you}, any ability class, not only equip/boast) and carries a floor so the discount cannot reduce the ability's total mana cost below one mana (a mana_floor: 1 key applied after the reduction in costs.ability_mana)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: ability_cost_reduction's affects_abilities offers equip, boast and any, where any is accepted only beside targeting or first_each_turn; and its discount is clamped only at zero generic by costs.ability_mana, so nothing expresses 'can't reduce the mana in that ability's activation cost to less than one mana'. Dropping the floor would make {2}-costed graveyard abilities free, which the card forbids
